title: Finding
description: Represents a vulnerability observation discovered during a network scan.

ip.description: IPv4 address of the affected device when the finding is device-specific

port.description: Affected network port when the finding is tied to a service

protocol.description: Transport protocol associated with the affected port

service.description: Service name associated with the finding

source.description: High-level origin of the finding, such as nmap_nse or nmap_vulners

source_script.description: Exact NSE script responsible for the finding

cve_id.description: CVE identifier when the finding maps to a known vulnerability

cvss_score.description: CVSS score reported by the source when available

description.description: Detailed explanation of why the finding matters

evidence.description: Snippet of scan output, banner, or proof that supports the finding

references.description: URLs or other references associated with the finding
